summary: Per-vehicle cost configuration shaping which vehicle the solver prefers (soft — never forces infeasibility).
range: Object: { fixed?, per_hour?, per_km?, per_order?, min_stop_load_*_penalty?, deadhead_*_penalty? }.
businessRules: Costs steer selection/ordering but never violate a hard constraint or force an otherwise-servable task unassigned.

costs defines: The cost attribute is used to define the cost of using the vehicle. It is a positive integer value with no specific unit of its own, but assumes the unit as per the value of travel_cost parameter. …
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.costs.fixed, vehicles.costs.per_km, vehicles.costs.per_hour. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
This is a soft constraint. Violations are penalized but don't make solutions infeasible.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: fixed + per_km cost makes a cheaper vehicle preferred.
Behavioral: raising fixed cost discourages using an extra vehicle.
